targeting.source: Shipped 333 is a hostile Hacker Style cast, selected area type 3, inclusive 4 m radius around the target, 14 m selection range and viral TestFunction 2. The exact targeted 80 b9 request is retained in proxy_020, lines 140965–140967.
targeting.runtime: The ordinary selected Hacker cast path checks learned loadout, stance, opposing live view and spawn, range and line of sight before debit. A landing validates the original target identity and location again. AbilityTargets evaluates each eligible area recipient's own viral contest.
targeting.test: SelectedFieldUsesTheAdmittedLiveSpawnAndCannotSplashAfterInvalidation covers pre-debit no-target, ally, stale, range, sight, style and unloaded refusals. It also covers spawn replacement, retreat and sight loss during a paid cast. SelectedFieldUsesThePrimaryCentreAndEachRecipientOwnContest verifies a deflected primary, a landed edge stun, and exclusions for a player just outside, an ally and a hidden view.

behavior-tests.source: Shipped 333 applies Stun state 102 for five base seconds and AddControlImmunityTimerVal creates the independent ten-second immunity.
behavior-tests.runtime: The existing status, immunity and ordinary control presentation remain on the selected cast path. No HP damage is applied. The landed field uses the original valid target centre.
behavior-tests.test: HackerStunAppliesImmunitySeparatelyAndRetainsItAfterTheStateEnds verifies duration, damage retention, separate immunity and reapplication. ActualNpcLandingDeflectsBeforeDamageDebuffAndProcAndOnlyRoutesToVisibleSameWorld covers a deflected NPC. The disposable control sweep replays the exact retained 333 request with its current target handle.
